note: Schema validation: portable usize bounds (32-bit targets), minimum/maximum checked against the integer field type (compile error instead of a wrapping cast; fractional bounds round inward), and 422 error paths use the serde deserialize name. Multipart derive: every form_data / try_from_multipart key is read in any order, an invalid or overflowing limit is a compile error, serde(skip) / skip_deserializing fields default instead of being required, and generic structs are supported.
